analysis.mode: PSNR (sigma=0.74) + signal validation on 5 support pairs
analysis.rationale: Pair 0: blur_motion:1 -> brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 gives PSNR 46.92 dB and CI 10/10 (unique_R/G/B diff 0, clipped fraction diff 0.02pp, overshoot 1%, zero-crossing 1%, hf/lf 0%). Support pairs 1-4: CI 10/10 on all (unique diffs 0, clip diffs <=0.12pp, hf_lf <=1%). Order blur->brightness is required: clean clipped_fraction=0.0001 while target=6.05%; darken-only clips 7.79%, darken->blur 2.19%, blur(sev1)->darken 5.91-6.01%; mean_shift -50.8 and variance_ratio 0.8357 vs target 0.8367 only reproduce in blur-first order. Motion angle is random in x_distortion (np.random.uniform(-90,90) per call) so PSNR on supports varies (22.57-39.65) while content-independent signals stay matched. Rejected: gaussian 29.27 dB (CI 8/10), lens 29.03 (9/10), glass 27.15 (8/10); JPEG excluded clean bb 1.012 ~= target 1.002; noise excluded (noiseless sim reproduces target noise_prior 0.74 floor); darken gamma/HSV variants excluded by clipping/mean signatures (gamma 0.28-0.35% clip, HSV shift 11.7% vs target 6.05%). No alternatives retained: all runner-ups PSNR<30 and CI<=9/10.
